description: Implement Apple design foundation: Update globals.css with Apple typography system, custom CSS variables for Apple colors, multi-layer soft shadow utilities, spring animation keyframes, custom scrollbar styles, and focus ring utilities. Update tailwind.config.js with Apple-specific design tokens (colors, border radius, spacing, font families).
steps: Read current app/globals.css and tailwind.config.js to understand existing structure

Update tailwind.config.js: Add Apple system fonts ('-apple-system', 'BlinkMacSystemFont', 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter'), extend colors with Apple palette (#007AFF blue, #34C759 green, #FF9500 orange, #FF3B30 red, #8E8E93 gray, #E5E5EA border, #F2F2F7 secondary bg, #FBFBFD tertiary bg, #1C1C1E text), update borderRadius to Apple values (sm: 10px, DEFAULT: 12px, lg: 16px, xl: 20px, 2xl: 24px), add Apple-specific spacing if needed

Update app/globals.css @layer base: Set body font to '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, Inter, sans-serif' with -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased, letter-spacing -0.016em, line-height 1.5, font-size 15px
Add Apple heading styles in globals.css: h1-h6 with letter-spacing -0.022em, line-height 1.2, appropriate weights (600-700)

Add CSS custom properties for Apple shadows in :root: --apple-shadow-card: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); --apple-shadow-elevated: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); --apple-shadow-button-hover: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,122,255,0.15); --apple-shadow-dialog: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)
Add custom scrollbar styles in globals.css: ::-webkit-scrollbar width 8px, track transparent, thumb #C7C7CC rounded-full, hover #8E8E93
Add spring animation keyframes in globals.css: @keyframes spring-scale and @keyframes spring-fade with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1) easing
Add Tailwind utility classes via @layer utilities: .apple-focus-ring (2px #007AFF ring with subtle shadow), .apple-card-shadow, .apple-elevated-shadow, .apple-smooth-scroll (scroll-behavior smooth)
Add smooth transition defaults: * { transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1) }
Verify colors render correctly in HSL format by converting Apple hex colors to HSL in CSS variables
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.js includes Apple font stack, Apple color palette (blue #007AFF, green #34C759, etc.), and Apple border radius values (10-24px)
globals.css has Apple typography (-apple-system font, letter-spacing, line-height), multi-layer shadow CSS variables, spring animation keyframes, custom scrollbar styles, and focus ring utilities
Dev server starts successfully and fonts/colors are applied
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no errors
Run 'npm run dev' and open http://localhost:3000
Inspect any page and verify font-family is -apple-system or SF Pro Display
Check browser DevTools computed styles to confirm Apple color values are applied
Verify smooth scrollbar styling appears on scrollable content
findings: Successfully implemented Apple design foundation. All changes applied without build errors. Updated tailwind.config.js with Apple font stack (SF Pro Display/Text, -apple-system), Apple color palette (blue #007AFF, green #34C759, orange #FF9500, red #FF3B30, gray #8E8E93, border #E5E5EA), and Apple border radius values (10-24px). Updated globals.css with Apple typography system (letter-spacing -0.016em, line-height 1.5, font-size 15px), multi-layer shadow CSS variables (card, elevated, button-hover, dialog), spring animation keyframes, custom scrollbar styles (8px width, rounded, #C7C7CC color), focus ring utilities, and smooth transition defaults using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1) easing. Build completed successfully with no errors. Ready for component layer implementation in next features.
